verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair privacy question for a SaaS meeting-notes product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only adjacent privacy controls: data retention policies, pausing recording, transcript redaction, and admin toggles for the MCP server and API. None of these is an opt-out from product telemetry or usage tracking, and "Keyword tracking" is a meeting-content feature, not telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
